requirements.Title: NGB Keyed Bottles with High Page Yield
requirements.Description: The printer must support new NGB keyed bottles, with 6K Black and 6K CMY page yield, and CMY bottle size greater than 8K.
requirements.Rationale: To increase ink capacity and reduce user intervention, supporting higher yield and competitive differentiation.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires compatibility with NOA-F, IDS, and bottle keying system.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer accepts and recognizes new NGB keyed bottles; achieves 6K Black and 6K CMY page yield; supports CMY bottle size >8K.

requirements.Title: Spill-Free Reliability for Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: The system must ensure spill-free reliability when users replace ink bottles.
requirements.Rationale: To enhance user experience and minimize mess or damage during bottle changes.
requirements.Dependencies: NGB keyed bottle design, IDS system.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: No ink spill occurs in >99.5% of bottle replacement events during testing.

requirements.Title: NOA-F with Metal Foiled Labyrinth and Lid Label
requirements.Description: The NOA-F (Next-Gen Output Assembly - F) must include a metal foiled labyrinth and lid label, with no change to click-on push-push and TDF mechanisms.
requirements.Rationale: Improved reliability and security for ink delivery and assembly.
requirements.Dependencies: NOA-F design, compatibility with existing assembly mechanisms.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F includes specified features and passes reliability and assembly tests without modification to push-push and TDF.

requirements.Title: Reuse SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie Ink
requirements.Description: The printer must reuse the SuperAmp Si Printhead Assembly (PHA) and Magi/Nessie pigment inks without reformulation.
requirements.Rationale: To leverage proven components, reduce development cost, and ensure supply chain efficiency.
requirements.Dependencies: Compatibility with new bottle and ink system.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie inks function without reformulation in the new printer system.

requirements.Title: Reliability and IDS Characterization & Modelling
requirements.Description: Reliability, Water Vapor Transmission Rate (WVTR), air gain, flow rate, and IDS (Ink Delivery System) must be characterized and modeled, including startup and NOA-F end-of-life.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures robust performance and predictive maintenance capability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Characterization and models completed; meet reliability targets over product lifecycle.

requirements.Title: Ink Stability Modelling (Tank & PQ Impact)
requirements.Description: Ink stability in the tank must be modeled and assessed for impact on print quality (PQ).
requirements.Rationale: To prevent print quality degradation over time due to ink instability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Stability model completed; PQ is within spec after prolonged tank storage.

requirements.Title: NOA-F as Service Part in Warranty Support
requirements.Description: NOA-F must be available as a service part for warranty support.
requirements.Rationale: Improves serviceability and reduces downtime for customers.
requirements.Dependencies: NOA-F part logistics and support systems.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F can be ordered and replaced under warranty service procedures.

requirements.Title: Acumen 6 on Lid
requirements.Description: The printer lid must integrate Acumen 6 (presumably a sensor or feature).
requirements.Rationale: To enable advanced features or compliance as required by Acumen 6.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Acumen 6 is integrated and passes functional validation.

requirements.Title: Factory Line Modifications for NOA-F and Ink Cart
requirements.Description: Modify existing SA14 line for NOA-F and add Magi ink cart and labelling tool in Orcus 5. Mold for 1 to 4 new keyed caps.
requirements.Rationale: To support new components in manufacturing.
requirements.Dependencies: SA14 line, Orcus 5, new cap molds.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Factory lines modified and validated for new parts and processes.

requirements.Title: Support Customer Replaceable PHA and NOA-F
requirements.Description: Design the printer for customer-replaceable Printhead Assembly (PHA) and NOA-F.
requirements.Rationale: Improves user convenience and reduces service costs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: End users can replace PHA and NOA-F without service intervention; validated by usability testing.

requirements.Title: Warranty Page Life Goal of 80K Pages
requirements.Description: The printer must meet a new warranty page life goal of 80,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Extends product life and reduces warranty claims.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer passes accelerated life testing for 80,000 pages without failure.

requirements.Title: Support PaaS (Print-as-a-Service) Model
requirements.Description: Enable the printer to support Print-as-a-Service (PaaS) business model, including consumer, SMB, and enterprise onboarding paths.
requirements.Rationale: Expands business opportunities and adapts to modern service models.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer can be provisioned and managed under PaaS model for all target segments.

requirements.Title: EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel Certification for PDL SKU
requirements.Description: Ensure the PDL SKU meets EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel environmental requirements.
requirements.Rationale: Compliance with global eco-labels and regulatory requirements.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product is certified for EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel prior to launch.

requirements.Title: Input/Output Tray Changes for Tank Protrusion
requirements.Description: Modify input and output trays to align with the increased tank protrusion and optimize overall size.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures product usability and maintains compact footprint despite larger tank.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Trays function correctly with tank protrusion; product size is minimized within constraints.

requirements.Title: 4.3” CGD Display Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate a 4.3-inch color graphical display (CGD) into the printer.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances user interface and accessibility.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 4.3” CGD is functional and passes usability tests.

requirements.Title: Leverage Sayan Sibstar Tubes with New Routing
requirements.Description: Use Sayan Sibstar tubes for ink delivery with new tube routing and integration.
requirements.Rationale: Improves ink flow and system reliability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Sayan Sibstar tubes are integrated and pass reliability and performance tests.

requirements.Title: Service Station Aerosol Management
requirements.Description: Update service station for improved aerosol management due to new tank design.
requirements.Rationale: Prevents aerosol-related issues and maintains print quality.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Aerosol levels are within safe limits during operation and maintenance.

requirements.Title: Carriage Dynamic and Force Model with New Weights
requirements.Description: Model and validate carriage dynamics and force with new tube routing and weights.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures reliable printhead movement and print quality.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Carriage system operates within force and dynamic tolerances under new configuration.

requirements.Title: Paper Path for Increased Page Life
requirements.Description: Design paper path to support increased page life and durability.
requirements.Rationale: Supports new 80K page life warranty goal.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Paper path passes endurance testing for 80,000 pages.

requirements.Title: Ink Maintenance Serviceable Part Post-80K Life
requirements.Description: Designate ink maintenance as a serviceable part at service centers after 80K page life.
requirements.Rationale: Facilitates extended printer use and serviceability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink maintenance can be replaced at service centers post-80K pages.

requirements.Title: New Make-Break and FI Connection for IDS
requirements.Description: Develop new make-break and fluidic interconnect (FI) connection for the ink delivery system.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures reliable and easy ink system assembly and maintenance.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: New connections pass reliability and user assembly tests.

requirements.Title: Leverage LEBI Ink-Tank with Increased Size, Keying, and LOI SHAID
requirements.Description: Use LEBI ink-tank with increased size, keying, and LOI SHAID for enhanced security and compatibility.
requirements.Rationale: Improves ink system security and prevents incorrect installation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Tank passes size, keying, and LOI SHAID validation tests.

requirements.Title: New IDS Startup Algorithm and Air Management
requirements.Description: Implement a new startup algorithm and air management for the ink delivery system.
requirements.Rationale: Improves startup reliability and print quality.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Startup passes reliability and print quality benchmarks.

requirements.Title: New Print Quality Goals & Depletion Definition
requirements.Description: Establish new print quality (PQ) goals and depletion definition to match page yield specifications.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures output meets user expectations and competitive benchmarks.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PQ meets or exceeds targets at specified depletion points.

requirements.Title: Reuse Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, Raccoon PSU
requirements.Description: Reuse Marconi Tux digital ASIC, Hannibal analog ASIC, and Raccoon power supply unit in the new platform.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces cost and leverages proven components.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Components function as required in new system without modification.

requirements.Title: Stingray Wi-Fi Module Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate the Stingray Wi-Fi module for wireless connectivity.
requirements.Rationale: Enables modern wireless features for end users.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Wi-Fi module passes connectivity, throughput, and security tests.

requirements.Title: FW Dune Firmware Platform
requirements.Description: Use Dune as the firmware platform for the printer.
requirements.Rationale: Standardizes software stack and leverages existing firmware capabilities.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Firmware is stable and all required features are functional on Dune platform.

requirements.Title: Gauss4.xx Security (HW & FW)
requirements.Description: Integrate Gauss4.xx hardware and firmware security features.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures compliance with HP security standards and protects against threats.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Security features pass internal and external security audits.

requirements.Title: 25/20ppm Print Speed (PDL: 25/19ppm)
requirements.Description: Printer must achieve print speeds of 25/20 pages per minute (PPM), with PDL at 25/19 PPM.
requirements.Rationale: Maintains competitive performance for target segments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer achieves specified print speeds in standard test environments.

requirements.Title: Support for SMB and Enterprise Solutions
requirements.Description: Integrate scan solution, SMB manageability, and enterprise support (WJA, HPSM, JAM).
requirements.Rationale: Expands addressable market and enhances feature set for business customers.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer integrates with required business solutions and passes interoperability tests.

requirements.Title: Client & Driver Support (HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, UFD)
requirements.Description: Support a wide range of clients and drivers including HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, and UFD.
requirements.Rationale: Maximizes compatibility with various operating environments and user needs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All listed drivers are available and pass installation and functional tests.

requirements.Title: Serviceability: Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Design for serviceable maintenance box to enable easy upkeep and reduce downtime.
requirements.Rationale: Improves serviceability and reduces total cost of ownership.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box is user/service replaceable and passes serviceability tests.

requirements.Title: Protect Micro/SMB Segments and Ink/Laser Profit Pool
requirements.Description: Product must be positioned and designed to protect HP's Micro/SMB segments and safeguard traditional ink/laser profit pools from competitors.
requirements.Rationale: Strategic market defense and revenue protection.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Market share in target segments is maintained or improved post-launch.

requirements.Title: Lead with LaserJet, Flank with PDL in Medium & Enterprise Segments
requirements.Description: Strategy must prioritize LaserJet leadership and PDL flanking for medium and enterprise segments to win over competitors as CISS grows.
requirements.Rationale: Strengthens competitive position in growing CISS market.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product adoption in medium/enterprise segments meets strategic goals.

requirements.Title: Grow CISS Profitable Share in New Segments
requirements.Description: The product must enable HP to grow profitable share in new segments with CISS.
requirements.Rationale: Business growth through market expansion.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Increased market share and profitability in new CISS segments.

requirements.Title: SuperAmp PHA Life at 65K (Constrain)
requirements.Description: SuperAmp PHA must have a life rating of 65,000 pages, considered a hard constraint.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures reliability and aligns with constrained priorities.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PHA passes 65K page life testing under standard conditions.

requirements.Title: Warranty Life of 2 Years (Optimize)
requirements.Description: The printer must support a warranty life of 2 years.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with market expectations and competitive offerings.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product warranty is valid for 2 years with failure rates within target limits.

requirements.Title: Host 12K-CMYK (Flexible)
requirements.Description: Printer should support hosting 12K page yield for CMYK as a flexible (non-mandatory) goal.
requirements.Rationale: Provides future scalability and differentiation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product supports 12K CMYK configuration if required by market.

requirements.Title: Trade Page 6K (Flexible)
requirements.Description: Printer should support trade page yield of 6K as a flexible (non-mandatory) goal.
requirements.Rationale: Allows for market-driven product variations.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product supports 6K trade page configuration if required by market.
